'''''Cage Warriors 174: London''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event produced by [[Cage Warriors]] that took place on June 20, 2024, in [[London]], England.

===Background===
A [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Flyweight Championship|Cage Warriors Flyweight Championship]] bout between current champion Shajidul Haque and Nicholas Leblond was expected to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-19 |title=Shaj Haque vs. Nicolas Blonde Booked For Cage Warriors 174 
|url=https://fightersonly.com/article/ext/86669 |access-date=2024-12-22 |website=Fighters Only |language=en-US}}</ref> However, Haque was forced to withdraw due to injury and was replaced by Amir Malekpour for the interim title.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-09 |title=Cage Warriors 174: London – Swedish Title Fight with Amir Malekpour 
|url=https://www.mmanytt.com/latest-news/cage-warriors-174-london-swedish-title-fight-with-amir-malekpour/ |access-date=2024-12-12 |website=MMAnytt.com |language=en}}</ref> In turn, Malekpour was forced to withdraw on medical grounds shortly after accepting the fight and Leblond faced Gerasimos Sioutis in a bantamweight bout instead.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-18 |title=Cage Warriors 174 in London: PrizeFighter Tournament and Top MMA Fights Live on UFC Fight Pass, this Saturday, July 20 
|url=https://www.blackbeltmag.com/cage-warriors-174-in-london-prizefighter-tournament-and-top-mma-fights-live-on-ufc-fight-pass-this |access-date=2024-12-22 |website=Black Belt Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref>

The One-Night of [[#Prize Fighter Bantamweight Tournament|Prize Fighter Bantamweight Tournament]] took place at the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-26 |title=Cage Warriors Prize Fighter Bouts Announced 
|url=https://fightersonly.com/article/ext/86727 |access-date=2024-12-22 |website=Fighters Only |language=en-US}}</ref>

'''''Cage Warriors 181: Newcastle''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event produced by [[Cage Warriors]] that took place on November 23, 2024, in [[Newcastle upon Tyne|Newcastle]], England.

===Background===
The event was headlined by a [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship|Cage Warriors Featherweight Championship]] bout between current champion Harry Hardwick and Keweny Lopes.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |date=2024-11-19 |title=Cage Warriors 181: Newcastle Final Card and Broadcast Times 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/cage-warriors-181-newcastle-final-card-and-broadcast-times/ |access-date=2024-12-23 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref>

A [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Women's Bantamweight Championship|Cage Warriors Women's Bantamweight Championship]] for the vacant title between Kennedy Freeman and Emilia Czerwińska was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-04 |title=Women's Bantamweight World Title Fight Confirmed for Newcastle 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/womens-bantamweight-world-title-fight-confirmed-for-newcastles-vertu-motors-arena/ |access-date=2024-12-23 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref> However, Czerwińska pulled out for unknown reason and was replaced by Mafalda Carmona.<ref name=":3"/>

A [[Cage Warriors#Cage Warriors Flyweight Championship|Cage Warriors Flyweight Championship]] bout between current champion Shaj Haque and Nicholas Leblond was rescheduled to take place the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-04 |title=Flyweight World Title Fight Confirmed for Newcastle 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/cage-warriors-flyweight-world-title-fight-in-newcastle/ |access-date=2024-12-23 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref> However, the bout was cancelled after adverse weather conditions prevented Leblond from travelling.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-11-22 |title=Cage Warriors 181: Newcastle – Weigh-In Results 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/cage-warriors-181-newcastle-weigh-in-results/ |access-date=2024-12-23 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref>
